requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding an obsolete MF resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: The RDATA consists of a single MADNAME field.
requirements.why_checkable: The MF RDATA serializer and parser can be checked for the single-field layout.

requirements.quote:
MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has a mail
                agent for the domain which will accept mail for
                forwarding to the domain.
requirements.condition: For the MADNAME field of an obsolete MF resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MADNAME as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The field representation and domain-name parser or serializer can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has a mail
                agent for the domain which will accept mail for
                forwarding to the domain.
requirements.condition: When interpreting MADNAME in an obsolete MF resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret MADNAME as the name of a host whose mail agent accepts mail for forwarding to the domain.
requirements.why_checkable: The MF record model and mail-routing interpretation can be checked against the stated host role.

requirements.quote:
MF records cause additional section processing which looks up an A type
record corresponding to MADNAME.
requirements.condition: When processing an MF resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform additional-section processing that looks up an A record corresponding to MADNAME.
requirements.why_checkable: An MF response can be checked for an additional-section address lookup using MADNAME.

requirements.quote:
MF is obsolete.  See the definition of MX and [RFC-974] for details ofw
the new scheme.  The recommended policy for dealing with MD RRs found in
a master file is to reject them, or to convert them to MX RRs with a
preference of 10.
requirements.condition: When MD resource records are found in a master file; the source names MD in the MF section, leaving intended record-type applicability unclear.
requirements.required_behavior: The recommended policy is to reject these records or convert them to MX resource records.
requirements.why_checkable: The loader policy is checkable, but the record-type mismatch prevents unambiguous applicability; the policy is advisory.

requirements.quote:
MF is obsolete.  See the definition of MX and [RFC-974] for details ofw
the new scheme.  The recommended policy for dealing with MD RRs found in
a master file is to reject them, or to convert them to MX RRs with a
preference of 10.
requirements.condition: When following the recommended policy by converting a master-file MD resource record to MX; the source names MD in the MF section, leaving intended record-type applicability unclear.
requirements.required_behavior: The recommended conversion assigns the MX record a preference of 10.
requirements.why_checkable: The converted MX preference is checkable, but the record-type mismatch prevents unambiguous applicability; this belongs to an advisory policy.
